messages.subject: editable table
parts: I'm trying to make some editable table using jQuery libraries (see http://www.datatables.net/release-datatables/examples/api/editable.html for an example). Has anybody already succeeded in using some kind of editable table within Shiny (edition din the table itself). The ultimate goal is to save edited data back to some DB when the user clicks on some "Save" button. Thx for your suggestions.
